statements.checked: All epsilon, all delta, arbitrary complex L3 functions; usual surface measure and exact cylinder normalization.
Full 1<=p<=3, q=2p-prime range; Euclidean and fixed local constant-curvature geometry, p=1 and p=3 endpoints.
Fixed translation-invariant phase, mixed rank and curvature, Bourgain condition, fixed small chart and delta range, full interpolation range.
Existence of p>2 arbitrarily close to 2 with h(p,0)=0; not all p asserted.
Inherited positive weights, repetitions allowed, full-time planks, per-index long-mark threshold, weighted incidence/cell count conclusion.

proofPassages.scope: Indexed model, critical exponent, direct geometric input statements, weighted extensions, local mass and common-plane proof.
Canonical profile/stationary packet statements and surrounding construction; entropy demand proof and velocity trace statement; projection constraints.
Pair pinning and information comparison, robust projection reduction, pinning bootstrap endpoints, five-case contradiction and complete discrete-to-analytic reduction.
Proofs of both consequences and direct transfer inputs.

dependencies.role: Dense shadings under convex clustering; converted to repeated weighted full-time line charts.

Explicit theta^-1/2 transversality cost; weights by repetition/rational approximation.
